mapper.select: SELECT o.order_num as "orderNum", o.store_id as "storeId", o.user_id as "userId", o.order_date as "orderDate", o.pay_method as "payMethod", o.delevery_status as "deleveryStatus", o.delevery_address1 as "deleveryAddress1", o.delevery_address2 as "deleveryAddress2", o.delevery_address3 as "deleveryAddress3", o.total_price as "totalPrice", o.used_point as "usedPoint", o.phone as "phone", o.request as "request", d.food_info as "foodInfo", s.store_name as "storeName", s.store_img as "storeImg", s.store_thumb as "storeThumb", s.delevery_tip as "deleveryTip", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(2000)) as "reviewContent", 0 as "score", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) as "reviewImg" FROM bm_order_user o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_NUM, LISTAGG(FOOD_INFO, '/') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDER_NUM) as food_info FROM BM_ORDER_DETAIL_USER GROUP BY ORDER_NUM ) d ON o.order_num = d.order_num LEFT JOIN bm_store s ON o.store_id = s.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.order_date DESC
